name: @forge-registry/cli
stderr:
Usage: forge [options] [command]

Verify, install, and publish MCP servers, A2A agents, and AI skills

Options:
  -v, --version                    output the version number
  -h, --help                       display help for command

Commands:
  search [options] [query]         Search the Forge registry
  verify [options] <package>       Check the trust status, manifest, and
                                   security of a package
  audit [options]                  Audit every MCP server configured in this
                                   project
  changes [options]                Show what changed in the packages this
                                   project depends on
  lock [options]                   Resolve this project's MCP servers and
                                   dependencies to exact versions
  inspect [options] <package>      Report a package's MCP tool surface (static
                                   — never executes the package)
  sandbox [options] <package>      Install a package in a no-network Docker
                                   container and watch its install scripts
  sbom [options] <package>         Fetch an entry's CycloneDX SBOM (with VEX)
                                   from the Forge registry
  eval [options] <suite> [target]  Run an eval suite against a local or
                                   published package
  install [options] <package>      Verify and install a package via npm
  policy                           Generate and verify signed runtime policy
                                   artifacts for gateways and CI
  publish [options]                Register or update a package in the Forge
                                   registry
  login [options]                  Authenticate with GitHub or GitLab (required
                                   for forge publish)
  skills                           Browse, install, and remove AI skills from
                                   the Forge registry
  guard                            PreToolUse hook: check packages against the
                                   registry before they install
  mcp                              Run the Forge MCP server over stdio (for AI
                                   clients)
  help [command]                   display help for command

Examples:
  $ forge search "web research"
  $ forge verify @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
  $ forge audit
  $ forge changes
  $ forge lock --audit
  $ forge inspect @upstash/context7-mcp
  $ forge sandbox @upstash/context7-mcp
  $ forge policy build --from-config .mcp.json
  $ forge sbom @upstash/context7-mcp -o sbom.cdx.json
  $ forge eval evals/forge-mcp-smoke-v1.json @upstash/context7-mcp
  $ forge install @upstash/context7-mcp
  $ forge publish
  $ forge login
  $ forge skills list
  $ forge skills add code-reviewer
  $ forge mcp
